requirement.text: The system is designed and architecture is planned privacy and data protections auditability in mind. Clear documentation on how API and services joining the SMART terminal system will affect the privacy and data Protection.

analysis.ethical_objective: Embed privacy, data protection, and auditability considerations into system design and architecture, and provide clear documentation describing the privacy and data-protection effects of APIs and services that join the SMART terminal system.
explicit_requirements: Design the system with privacy, data protection, and auditability in mind.
Plan the system architecture with privacy, data protection, and auditability in mind.
Provide clear documentation on how APIs joining the SMART terminal system affect privacy and data protection.
Provide clear documentation on how services joining the SMART terminal system affect privacy and data protection.
supported_implications: Privacy, data protection, and auditability are required considerations during both system design and architectural planning.
The privacy and data-protection implications of joining APIs and services must be documented clearly.
The documentation applies to APIs and services that join the SMART terminal system.
constraints: The requirement applies to the SMART terminal system.
Documentation concerns the effects of APIs and services joining the system on privacy and data protection.
Auditability is explicitly required for design and architecture, but is not explicitly stated as a required topic of the joining API/service documentation.
ambiguities: The specific privacy, data-protection, and auditability measures to be incorporated are not defined.
The intended audience, format, location, and level of detail for the documentation are not specified.
It is unclear whether 'joining' means integrating, connecting to, registering with, or otherwise participating in the SMART terminal system.
The requirement does not define how the privacy or data-protection effects of an API or service should be assessed or described.
The scope of APIs and services covered, including whether it includes existing as well as future integrations, is unspecified.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume particular privacy or data-protection laws, standards, or policies.
Do not assume a specific audit logging, monitoring, traceability, or reporting mechanism.
Do not assume that APIs or services must be approved, blocked, certified, or assessed before joining the system.
Do not assume prescribed documentation templates, publication channels, update schedules, or review processes.
Do not assume that the documentation must cover auditability, unless separately required.
Do not infer specific technical controls such as encryption, access control, consent management, data minimization, or retention limits.
possible_operational_aspects: Privacy, data protection, and auditability are considered as system-design and architecture-planning criteria.
Clear documentation describes the privacy and data-protection effects associated with an API or service joining the SMART terminal system.

initial_draft.title: Privacy-Aware and Auditable System Integration
initial_draft.description: As a user, I want the SMART terminal system to be designed with privacy, data protection, and auditability in mind, so that I can examine the privacy and data-protection effects of APIs and services joining the system.
work_items: The SMART terminal system design and architecture shall incorporate privacy, data protection, and auditability considerations.
Clear documentation shall describe how APIs joining the SMART terminal system affect privacy and data protection.
Clear documentation shall describe how services joining the SMART terminal system affect privacy and data protection.

criterion_support.explanation: The role introduces no unsupported domain-specific stakeholder claim.

unresolved_issues: Work items 2 and 3 unnecessarily split one documentation obligation into near-duplicate conditions.
The source does not define the specific privacy, data-protection, or auditability considerations that demonstrate compliance with the design and architecture obligation.

issues.problem: The two documentation work items are near-duplicates. APIs and services are jointly covered by one source obligation, so separating them adds repetition without distinguishing a meaningful independent condition.
issues.recommended_change: Consolidate the API and service documentation conditions into one work item while retaining both integration types and their privacy and data-protection effects.

issues.problem: Whether privacy, data protection, and auditability have been incorporated 'in mind' cannot be fully verified because the source supplies no concrete criteria, measures, or definitions for those considerations.
issues.recommended_change: Retain the source-level obligation without adding invented measures; any greater verification specificity would require clarification of the source requirement.
